scenes.title: An operator combines input values
caption: Every output receives a weighted contribution from the inputs.
Rows are output positions. Columns are input positions.

scenes.title: Position shifts select displacement diagonals
caption: A shift sends every sample the same number of positions forward.
The periodic grid makes each shift an exact, reversible permutation.

scenes.title: Each displacement needs its own weights
caption: The shift chooses the displacement. The weights choose the contribution.
One diagonal connects every input to its displaced output.

scenes.title: Wave-number shifts supply phase patterns
caption: A wave-number shift multiplies each sample by a unit complex number.
Across position, those multipliers form a Fourier pattern.

scenes.title: Fourier patterns build the weights
caption: Weight the phase patterns, then add them.
Their real and imaginary parts combine to reproduce the chosen weights.

scenes.title: All displacements build the operator
caption: Each displacement supplies one diagonal. Together they cover every entry.
Adding the weighted translations reconstructs the whole operator.

scenes.title: The same operator works on different states
caption: Change the input. Keep all 64 operator coefficients fixed.
Direct multiplication and the translation expansion give the same output.

scenes.title: From samples to functions
caption: Refine the samples and widen the interval. Sums become integrals.
Position shifts select displacements. Fourier patterns supply the weights.

finite_model: Exact N=8 periodic Weyl basis, not a finite-dimensional CCR
